copy.en:
Pack by Zone, Travel Neater
Two compartments and X-shaped straps organize clothing and hold it in place.
Nass-Trocken separation bag included
Separate damp and dry clothes
copy.zh:
分区收纳，行李更整齐
双区布局配合X型固定带，帮助衣物分类并保持位置稳定
配备干湿分离袋
干湿衣物分开收纳
copy.de:
Nach Zonen packen, ordentlicher reisen
Zwei Fächer und X-Gurte ordnen Kleidung und halten sie an ihrem Platz.
Nass-Trocken-Tasche im Lieferumfang enthalten
Feuchte und trockene Kleidung getrennt verstauen
copy.fr:
Rangez par zone, voyagez mieux

Pochette humide-sec incluse
Séparez les vêtements humides et secs
copy.it:
Organizza per zone, viaggia meglio

Sacca separa umido-asciutto inclusa
Separa i capi umidi da quelli asciutti
copy.es:
Organiza por zonas, viaja mejor
Dos compartimentos y correas en X organizan la ropa y la mantienen en su sitio.
Bolsa seco-húmedo incluida
Separa la ropa húmeda de la seca

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为箱内双区分隔与X型固定带，核心购买理由是帮助衣物分类，并在行李箱内保持相对稳定；辅助证据为随附干湿分离袋，用于将干衣物与湿衣物分开收纳。不得延伸为防水、防漏、密封或绝对稳固，也不能展示未经资料证实的TSA密码设置步骤。PC画布为1464×600：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2自上而下排列；右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]，展示打开的旅行箱，箱体略向左转约15°，完整呈现涤纶内衬、左右双区、X型固定带和干湿分离袋。第1行对应整体分区收纳场景；第2行对应双区结构与X型固定带的局部视觉证明；第3行对应干湿分离袋的近景；第4行对应干湿衣物分开摆放的使用收益。移动端为1200×900：上方产品与轻量旅行场景区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，保持标题→说明→两条细节的阅读顺序，并确保四行文字有足够间距。使用低饱和中性色、自然侧光、柔和阴影和干净的欧洲现代旅行摄影风格，突出内衬纹理、分隔边界、固定带和干湿袋的材质差异。字体预留Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，支持说明常规字重，细节使用短句和清晰层级；德语文案预留约20%横向扩展。产品资料确认有TSA密码锁，但没有密码设置详情步骤或图示证据，本模块不展示或说明设置流程。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的双区分隔、X型固定带、干湿分离袋及干湿衣物分开收纳事实；不得声称防水、防漏、密封、绝对稳固、静音或其他未经证实的性能。不得添加TSA密码设置步骤、虚构认证、测试、官方背书、评分、促销信息或竞品商标。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ split-layout travel photography banner for the YWJ 13A travel suitcase, with no rendered text, no logos, no labels, and no symbols. PC composition: 1464x600 canvas, reserve a clean, uncluttered text-safe area on the left at x=5%, y=10%, width=38%, height=80%; place the product and visual proof on the right at x=49%, y=8%, width=46%, height=84%. Show the suitcase opened and angled approximately 15 degrees to the left, clearly revealing the polyester lining, two organized packing compartments, X-shaped securing straps, and the included dry-wet separation bag. Use a refined business-travel packing scene with neatly grouped dry clothing in one compartment and a separate damp-clothing cue beside the dry-wet bag, without implying waterproofing or leakproofing. Use low-saturation neutral European modern travel photography, natural side light, soft shadows, realistic material textures, restrained navy and warm orange accents, and a premium but credible mood. Include one close visual emphasis on the X-shaped straps and compartment boundary, and one close visual emphasis on the dry-wet bag, while keeping the suitcase as the dominant product. Mobile composition: 1200x900 canvas, reserve the upper product and travel-scene area at x=8%, y=5%, width=84%, height=53%, and leave the lower area at x=5%, y=64%, width=90%, height=31% clean and quiet for copy; preserve the visual reading order from overall two-zone packing to X-straps, dry-wet bag, and separating damp and dry clothes. Do not depict TSA combination-setting instructions because no verified steps or diagrams are supplied. No rendered text anywhere in the image.
